summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; extends ADR-0048 and complements, does not supersede, ADR-0044; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery single-writer lock plus LKG/generation/artifact/source/policy/query/main verification; LKG may predate main only as ancestor with all indexed and bundled inputs byte-matching main; restore source snapshot, v2 catalog, consumer projections, v1 compatibility catalog; replay query gate and canonical Locator smoke; stale LKG cannot override newer main; failed restore rolls four layers/current pointer back and verifies prior bytes; publication activation rollback domain includes four layers,current,LKG,success evidence; current written last; control-plane scripts/tools must match pinned main; locks recover definitively dead/reused owner or malformed lock after 60s, otherwise conflict; pruning only prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune, never publication/recovery; protect current,LKG,five newest valid successful added-to-main generations; no mtime ordering; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized directories reported not deleted; pruning uses canonical current-main policy, intent and target authorization, atomic isolation and per-target evidence; failures append-only logs/knowledge-context and never pruned; retention policy knowledge/policies/generation-retention.v1.json requires policy and ADR update
